lines.en: I skim low over the water
My spread wings cast a whole shadow
Two beats, then I glide
My claws stay tucked in flight
I fly along the line of the riverbank

lines.zh: 我打了个弯，翅尖几乎碰到树
lines.en: I bank and my wingtip nearly touches a tree
My crest flattens in the wind
I drop from high up onto the scrub
I perch on a dead branch a while

lines.zh: 我起飞时扬起一点尘土
lines.en: My takeoff kicks up a little dust

lines.zh: 我收翅时落在枝的正中
lines.en: I fold my wings and land dead center on the branch

lines.zh: 我顺着上升气流往高处走
lines.en: I ride the updraft higher
I fly low, close to the water
My claws dangle in the air
I hang on the branch without moving
My wing membrane hangs slack
I am watching the ground

lines.zh: 我歪过头，用一只眼看你
lines.en: I tilt my head and fix one eye on you.
I am not moving, the wind is
I wipe my beak on the branch
I wait for something small to walk by
My toes grip the branch tightly
I watch my reflection on the water

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一截枯木
lines.en: I stay still like a piece of dead wood

lines.zh: 我把喙埋进胸前的羽里
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my chest feathers
I wait for the wind to drop

lines.zh: 我连眼皮都不动，等你先动
lines.en: I don't even blink; I wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我用脚趾整理了一下羽毛
lines.en: I preen with my toes
You stand inside my shadow
I am much higher than you
Your head moves, I see it clearly
Come closer and I take off

lines.zh: 你手指动一下，我就记住
lines.en: If a finger twitches, I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 我不是能靠过来的东西
lines.en: I am not something you can just approach
You're hiding a rope and a net in your hands.
Once I fly you cannot reach me
This riverbank is my hunting ground
You had best not stop here
What are you doing down there
The way you look up is comical

lines.zh: 翼膜被扯了一下，我飞不稳
lines.en: My wing membrane is yanked and I can't hold a line.

lines.zh: 爪下一滑，我在枝上晃了晃
lines.en: My grip slips and I sway on the branch.
Several beats before I balanced
My wing bone hurts
I dropped a stretch from above
I landed on the ground, feet first

lines.zh: 这一下让我没法马上飞
lines.en: That stopped me flying at once
I spread my wings to shield myself
I look up toward what struck me
I can still walk on my feet
Is there still blood dripping off that meat?
You raised it up

lines.zh: 你举得越高，我越看不清
lines.en: The higher you hold it, the less I can make out.
That is not enough for one bite of mine
I take only what has just died
I prefer something that runs
Set the meat down, then step back

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要下来
lines.en: I have not decided whether to come down
You are looking up at me, good

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，还没打算落
lines.en: I ruffle my wings; I'm not landing yet.
You touched my claws
My wings snap open

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我差点掉下来
lines.en: We collided, I nearly fell

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的翅骨上
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my wing bone
Two beats and I steadied

lines.zh: 我退到枝头更高的地方
lines.en: I retreat to a higher perch
That cost me my poise
I look down at you once
No room to fold my wings

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，翅尖还是碰到你
lines.en: I step aside, yet my wing tip still clips you.
I do such things in the air

lines.zh: 我的巢在崖上，不在你的地上
lines.en: My nest is on the cliff, not on your ground
I am busy this season
I have no time for what you ask
My mate flies higher than I do
I turn my head toward the water
Such things are not done on the riverbank
I go back to watching the water
I beat my wings once
I am ignoring you now
I dive and snatch it up
This fits my beak just right
I carry it up to the branch
Something is moving on the ground
I press it with my claws

lines.zh: 这东西太瘦，塞不住我的喙
lines.en: It's too scrawny to fill my beak.
I pick the hide open with my beak

lines.zh: 我叼着它在空中转了一圈
lines.en: I circle in the air with it in my beak
I will keep this to eat slowly
I dropped it and picked it up again
Something is running on the ground
I rose to my feet on the branch

lines.zh: 这个距离我一俯冲就到
lines.en: One dive covers this distance
I spread my wings to drop
Its back is toward me
I note the block it stands on
This is the second meal today
I start sliding downward

lines.zh: 我的影子先落到它身上
lines.en: My shadow hits it first
It moved, perfect
That small one cannot see me now

lines.zh: 我把三只脚趾全撑开了
lines.en: I spread all three toes wide.

lines.zh: 我从它的正面绕到后面
lines.en: I swing from its front to its back
The prey around here is mine

lines.zh: 我吊在它正上方，翅不动
lines.en: I hang right above it, wings still.
Each circle I drop lower
It never lifts its head
The wind pushes me higher
I hold steady on this current
A little longer and it is time
I extend my claws
I know its route
I approach from behind
One fold of the wings and I drop.

lines.zh: 我在等它走到没有遮挡的地方
lines.en: I wait for it to reach open ground
I hold my wings still
Its shape grows smaller
I fly with the light
I climb a little higher
I dive and strike with my claws
My beak follows down

lines.zh: 这一下带着我整个体重
lines.en: This carries my whole weight
I snatch once and rise
My wingbeat pushed it back half a step
I land and take off at once
I kick with my toes
This blow was finished in the air
I circle back and come down again

lines.zh: 我的爪子先碰到它的背
lines.en: My claws touch its back first
I slam down from above and to the side
I bite and pull upward
My wing slaps its face

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我自己也晃
lines.en: This knocked me off balance too
I come down over the riverbank
My wingspan first spreads over the ground
An Early Cretaceous Brazilian style

lines.zh: 我的名字意思是玩偶的指
lines.en: My name means a doll's finger
I settle on a dead branch

lines.zh: 我看看这片地方有什么
lines.en: Let me see what this place has
The wind comes from behind me
I open my beak and test the air
The water here is quite good
I beat my wings twice

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在水面上
lines.en: My shadow falls on the water first
I fly in from a distant cliff

lines.zh: 我落地的动静吓走了几只鸟
lines.en: My landing scares off a few birds

lines.zh: 我在这里能看清整条河
lines.en: From here I can see the whole river
One wingbeat and I stop
My beak is harder than it looks
I tilt my head back and call once
I draw my claws into my feathers
Fire seared my wing membrane

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，翅膀折了一下
lines.en: I fell from height and a wing folded wrong
Water came up to my chest
The shockwave turned my wings over
An arrow passed through my wing membrane

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的翅骨发僵
lines.en: That magic stiffened my wing bones

lines.zh: 我已经两天没抓到东西了
lines.en: I have caught nothing for two days
Lightning struck my wings
There is no riverbank below
